research.question: What SC 1.4.11 requires of text field borders and of disabled controls.
research.reason: The brief asked for the field border contrast.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.4.11: Non-text Contrast (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: 3:1 against adjacent colors outside the component; inactive components are exempt; an identifying input border must meet 3:1.

research.summary: The field border passes against the surface in every palette; disabled controls are exempt.
